decisions.reason: LHD loaders fit squarely within the firm's core underground mining and tunnelling expertise. Only one year has passed, too early to judge results against aspirations. Engineering, service and parts capabilities supply slack to carry the product while results remain uncertain.

Underground dump trucks complement the LHD loaders and draw on the same application know-how and after-sales network. With no evidence of a shortfall after one year, there is no trigger for problemistic search, so the firm keeps the product.
